concerns.text: FR-005 mandates flagging VIF > 5, but the plan (Summary, Complexity Tracking, Research) consistently enforces VIF > 33 based on a 'verified fact'. The plan does not explicitly resolve this contradiction or confirm that the spec's FR-005 threshold is intentionally overridden by the project-specific verified fact, leaving the success criterion for FR-005 ambiguous in the plan.

FR-009 requires splitting data into training and hold-out sets with '[deferred]' ratios. The plan mentions '5-fold cross-validation' and 'hold-out set' but does not explicitly describe the stratified sampling strategy or the specific split ratio (e.g., 80/20) intended to satisfy the '[deferred]' placeholder in FR-009, risking unbacked implementation of the split logic.
